request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply:
A preliminary CBO estimate from March 2010 projected that the ACA together with reconciliation changes would reduce federal deficits by $138 billion over 2010–2019 (CRS R41126, PDF p. 4). This was a projection, not an accounting of the law’s eventual budget impact. Separately, CBO and JCT projected $391.7 billion in health-related revenues over 10 years; that is a revenue component, not the law’s net effect (CRS R41128, PDF p. 4).

[See the brief for details and evidence.](output/briefs/case-20261025-182801-9f9a.html)
reply.reasoning: Verified findings provide a contemporaneous whole-law deficit projection and a separate revenue estimate. The available reports do not establish the realized budget impact.
